<p class="h2">Frequently Asked Questions</p>

<div class="faq-item">

<div class="faq-q">Can I switch from WordPress to Next.js later?</div>

<p class="faq-a">Yes. Content migrates to a headless CMS; existing URLs redirect — no ranking loss. Expect 4–8 weeks. The sooner you switch, the fewer plugin dependencies to untangle.</p>

</div>

<div class="faq-item">

<div class="faq-q">Can I edit a Next.js site without a developer?</div>

<p class="faq-a">Yes. Paired with Sanity, Strapi, or Contentful you get a friendly editing interface. Most clients manage their own content after a short onboarding session.</p>

</div>

<div class="faq-item">

<div class="faq-q">Does Next.js work with Laravel?</div>

<p class="faq-a">Perfectly. Next.js handles the frontend; Laravel handles the backend — APIs, auth, database, queues. One of the most powerful full-stack combinations in 2026.</p>

</div>

<div class="faq-item">

<div class="faq-q">Is Next.js only for large companies?</div>

<p class="faq-a">Not at all. Small businesses often benefit most — they rarely have IT staff to handle WordPress maintenance. Handles 50 or 50,000 visitors without any changes.</p>

</div>
